title: Custom Software Engineer
tagsAndSkills: software engineer,sap,issue resolution,data capture,costing,ai,mrp,llm
jobDescription:
Project Role :Custom Software Engineer


Project Role Description :Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.
Must have skills :SAP PP Production Planning Control Discrete Industries

Good to have skills :NA
Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

Summary
You will design, configure, and enhance SAP Production Planning (PP) processes for discrete manufacturing environments while using AI assisted development tools and copilots to accelerate requirement analysis, configuration, testing, documentation, and issue resolution. The role focuses on delivering efficient production planning, shop floor execution, and material staging processes while integrating pre built AI services where beneficial. No deep AI model engineering, vector DB work, RAG, or agentic system development is required.


Key Responsibilities
Functional Technical Delivery
Configure and support SAP PP processes including:
oMaterial Requirement Planning (MRP)
oProduction Orders Execution
oRoutings, Work Centers BOM Management
oCapacity Planning Scheduling
oBackflushing Costing Integration
oGoods Movements Shop floor Reporting
Use AI copilots to accelerate:
oFunctional specification creation
oRouting/BOM validation
oTest case generation for MRP, order creation, confirmations
oDocumentation automation (FS/TS/SOPs)
Support full lifecycle delivery:requirements, design, configuration, SIT/UAT, deployment, hypercare support.
Integrate PP with MM, QM, SD, FI/CO, and shop floor systems (MES), leveraging standard APIs and middleware.
AI Assisted Productivity
Use AI copilots for:
oAutomated summarization of requirements and change impacts
oAnalysis of MRP exceptions and planning alerts
oValidation of order execution and production variances
oFaster defect isolation in BOM/routing/work center configurations
Integrate pre built AI services into production workflows, such as:
oPredictive insights (e.g., potential material shortages or order delays)
oIntelligent classification of production issues
oAutomated summarization of production batch deviations
oSmart suggestions based on historical production performance
Use LLM assisted troubleshooting to reduce time spent analyzing MRP exception messages, order failures, and material shortages.
Governance, Quality Collaboration
Ensure compliance with production governance, change controls, data accuracy standards, and audit policies.
Participate in workshops, solution reviews, and process optimization discussions enhanced by AI generated insights.
Collaborate with production, quality, warehouse, procurement, cost controlling, and integration teams to deliver end to end planning excellence.
Create reusable templates, checklists, test packs, and AI enabled best practices for SAP PP delivery.

Required Skills Experience
SAP PP Expertise
Strong understanding of discrete manufacturing processes including BOM/routing management, production order cycles, capacity planning, scheduling, and MRP.
Experience with integration across MM (material availability), QM (inspection lots), SD (demand), and FI/CO (costing).
Familiarity with order confirmations, settlements, and shop floor data capture processes.
AI Ready Skills
Ability to use AI copilots, automated documentation tools, and AI assisted test accelerators.
Comfortable embedding pre built AI capabilities into production planning or execution (not custom model building).
Awareness of responsible AI usage and limitations in manufacturing and planning environments.
General Professional Skills
Strong analytical and problem solving skills related to production variability, MRP outcomes, and resource planning.
Ability to translate manufacturing requirements into scalable SAP PP configurations.
Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and operational teams.
Continuous learning mindset with comfort adopting AI assisted workflows.

Good to Have
SAP PP Certification (S/4HANA Manufacturing).
Experience with MES systems, shop floor integrations, or IoT enabled production data.
Exposure to EWM/WM, PM, or APO/IBP environments.
Familiarity with automated testing tools (Tricentis, CBTA).

Outcome Expectations
Deliver faster, more reliable SAP PP solutions using AI enabled productivity tools.
Improve planning accuracy, resource utilization, and production stability.
Act as a bridge between manufacturing teams, SAP engineering teams, and AI native experts when deeper AI capabilities are required.


Additional Information
A 15 years full time education is required.
Qualification15 years full time education

Summary
Build AI native, cloud ready SAP solutions on ABAP Cloud by combining deep ABAP and SAP platform expertise with agentic AI architectures, LLM tooling, and rapid experimentation. AI Native SAP Application Build
Design and build ABAP Cloud applications that embed LLM driven intelligence into SAP business processes.

Agentic LLM Integration

Quality, Safety Reliability
Implement evaluation frameworks (offline and online) for AI behaviors integrated with SAP processes.
Design guardrails for authorization, data privacy, action boundaries, and error handling.
Build observability into AI enabled SAP applications (telemetry, logging, failure analysis).
Rapid Experimentation Scale Out
Prototype quickly, demo frequently, and iterate based on business feedback.
Move AI prototypes into enterprise grade SAP production systems with performance, security, and compliance in mind.
Continuously refine AI behavior, prompts, and orchestration strategies.

SAP ABAP Cloud (RAP, CDS, OData, clean core principles).

Strong software engineering fundamentals (design, testing, CI/CD).
Ability to translate business problems into AI enabled SAP solutions.

Intelligent SAP applications that reason, retrieve, and act, not just automate.

Scalable, secure AI powered SAP extensions aligned with clean core principles.
Foundation for autonomous, AI driven enterprise workflows.

SAP Datasphere is positioned as a data warehousing solution with integration capabilities.
Core Responsibilities

Design and implement governed data products using Datasphere concepts such as Spaces and shareable models/views, enabling teams to explore, transform, and share curated datasets across domains.
Build semantic models that are fit for both analytics and AI consumption (clear entity definitions, measures, hierarchies, lineage-friendly design).
2) Retrieval + Grounding (RAG) over Enterprise Data
Create grounded AI experiences by connecting LLM applications to Datasphere s curated models and enterprise sources (SAP and non SAP), ensuring responses are traceable to governed data.
Engineer retrieval strategies that respect domain boundaries (spaces), freshness needs, and access controls, so AI outputs remain reliable and compliant.
3) Hybrid Modernization Migration (BW bridge patterns)
Enable transition paths from legacy warehouse investments by leveraging approaches such as reusing SAP BW models and skills with Datasphere / BW bridge, supporting phased cloud modernization.

Embed quality controls, validation checks, and reproducible transformations as part of the delivery lifecycle.
5) Agentic Orchestration Tooling
Build data agents that can plan, call tools (query/metadata/lineage), retrieve context, and generate answers with citationsbacked by deterministic checks and fallback behaviors.
Implement prompt templates, tool schemas, and safe action boundaries for enterprise-grade usage.
6) Evaluation, Observability Responsible AI
Establish offline/online evaluation loops (golden questions, regression suites, behavior tests) for conversational analytics and data agents.
Add telemetry for AI interactions (latency, grounding rate, failure modes) to improve reliability and cost efficiency.

Drive reusable patterns and accelerators for repeatable delivery across domains.

SAP BTP Datasphere:data modeling, spaces, sharing patterns, enterprise semantic design.

jobDescription:
About the Role

  • We are looking for a visionary AI Video Artist who is not just a prompter, but a true technical creator.
  • You sit at the intersection of Visual Effects (VFX), Game Engines, and Generative AI.
  • You will be responsible for creating hyper-realistic, cinematic video content by blending traditional compositing tools with state-of-the-art AI platforms.
  • We don't just want "AI videos"we want production-grade realism.
  • You must understand lighting, camera movement, and consistency, using AI as a power tool to accelerate high-end workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Creation: Conceptualize and produce high-fidelity video content using a hybrid workflow of AI generation and manual VFX polishing.
  • Advanced AI Prompting: Utilize tools like Runway (Gen-3), Kling, Midjourney, and Sora/Veo to generate base assets with precise camera control and character consistency.
  • VFX & Compositing: Take AI-generated raw footage and refine it using After Effects, Nuke, or DaVinci Resolve.
  • Fix artifacts, handle color grading, and ensure temporal stability (no "flickering").
  • 3D & Gaming Integration: Work with Unreal Engine 5 or Blender to create realistic environments and integrate digital avatars if required.
  • Character Consistency: Train or fine-tune models (LoRAs/ControlNet) to ensure characters look exactly the same across different shots and angles.
  • R&D: Stay updated daily on the newest AI tools.
  • If a new model drops on Hugging Face or GitHub, you should be the first to test it.

Required Skills & Toolset 1.

  • The "Real" Tech Stack (Non-Negotiable): VFX/Editing: Mastery of Adobe After Effects (Compositing, Roto), Premiere Pro, and DaVinci Resolve (Color Grading).
  • 3D Basics: Familiarity with Blender or Unreal Engine (Camera setting, Lighting, Environment design).
  • The AI Stack (Deep Knowledge Required): Video Gen: Runway Gen-3 Alpha, Kling AI, Luma Dream Machine, or Haiper.
  • Image Gen: Midjourney v6 (Advanced Parameters), Stable Diffusion (ComfyUI workflows are a huge plus).
  • Lip-Sync & Voice: ElevenLabs, HeyGen, or LivePortrait.
  • Optimization: Topaz Video AI (Upscaling) and interpolation tools.
  • Soft Skills: "Director's Eye": You understand cinematographyfocal lengths, shutter angles, lighting setups (Rim light, Key light), and composition.
  • Problem Solving: AI makes mistakes.
  • You must know how to fix "weird hands" or "glitchy eyes" manually in post-production.

Nice-to-Have (Bonus Points)

  • Experience in the Gaming Industry (Level Design, Cinematics, or Character Rigging).
  • Knowledge of ComfyUI Node systems for complex Stable Diffusion workflows.
  • Experience with Python scripting for automating media workflows.
  • Background in traditional art or photography.
  • Who You Are You don't just type "Make a cool video" into ChatGPT.
  • You write detailed prompts like "Cinematic wide shot, 35mm lens, volumetric lighting, cyberpunk street, unreal engine 5 render style --ar 16:9".
  • You are frustrated when AI video looks "wobbly" and you know exactly how to stabilize it.
  • You have an open mindset: You are willing to relearn your workflow every month as technology changes.
  • Submission Requirement Please do not send just a CV.
  • You must share a Portfolio or Showreel demonstrating: AI-Generated Video work (mentioning the tools used).
  • Any VFX breakdowns (Before/After) showing how you fixed/improved raw AI output.

WHATS IN IT FOR YOU

As part of our Analytics practice, you will join a worldwide network of over 20k+ smart and driven colleagues experienced in leading AI/ML/Statistical tools/Agentic AI systems, methods and applications. From data to analytics and insights to actions, our forward-thinking consultants provide analytically-informed, issue-based insights at scale to help our clients improve outcomes and achieve high performance.

A Consultant/Manager/Analyst for Customer Data Platforms serves as the day-to-day marketing technology point of contact and helps our clients get value out of their investment into a Customer Data Platform (CDP) by developing a strategic roadmap focused on personalized activation. You will be working with a multidisciplinary team of Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Digital Marketers.

Enterprise SAP EWM Delivery

As Business Resilience Manager within Ecolabs Global Business Solutions+ (GBS+) Enterprise AI organization, you will lead the execution of a critical capabilityensuring the continuity and resilience of essential global services. GBS+ is a multifunctional shared services platform supporting Finance, Supply Chain, Marketing, Legal, HR, Real Estate, and Automation across five global locations. In this role, you will own the development, testing, and continuous improvement of business continuity and resilience plans, enabling both GBS+ and AI operations to withstand and recover from disruptions. You will provide strategic oversight, expert guidance, and handson support to proactively manage risk, strengthen preparedness, and drive effective incident response. Reporting to the Sr. Director of Strategy Governance, you will partner closely with functional leaders to embed resilience into business planning, elevate organizational readiness, and ensure alignment with enterprise standards.

This position is located at Ecolabs GBS Global Service Delivery Center in Pune, India (hybrid schedule, 60% time in the office, working the 12 pm-9 pm IST shift Mon-Fri)

Whats in it For You:

  • The opportunity to take on some of the worlds most meaningful challenges, helping customers achieve clean water, safe food, and healthy environments
  • The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth
  • The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives, and ideas to achieve our best
  • Be part of an outstanding team with relentless focus on improvement through digital enhancements, process automation and AI opportunities

What You Will Do:

  • Partner with functional and site stakeholders to conduct risk assessments and business impact assessments, evaluating the impact of potential disruptions across GBS+ processes and global locations
  • Define, prioritize, and lead risk mitigation initiatives aligned to business priorities and service criticality
  • Own the development, maintenance, and maturation of sustainable Business Continuity Plans (BCPs) across GBS+ functions and locations to reduce business interruption risk
  • Design and deliver BCP training, simulations, and exercises; analyze results to identify gaps, drive improvements, and reinforce a culture of preparedness
  • Establish and govern a structured cadence for BCP testing, review, and updates to ensure plans remain current with organizational changes and site operations
  • Maintain an inventory of AI-supported services and process dependencies; tier criticality and document potential failure modes
  • Define continuity and recovery targets for AI-enabled capabilities (e.g., Recovery Time Objective where applicable)
  • Design, document, and test fallback procedures when AI is unavailable, including manual workarounds, human review queues, and nonAI alternatives (rules-based logic, templates, and standard operating procedures)
  • Plan and facilitate resilience exercises that include AI outage and degraded-quality scenarios; validate business readiness, recovery steps, and communications to internal stakeholders
  • Support GBS+ leadership during real disruption events, coordinating response activities and ensuring effective execution of continuity plans
  • Collaborate with digital, technology, and operations teams to strengthen the resilience of critical systems and services, including resilience plans for AI-supported services
  • Monitor, analyze, and report resilience metricsincluding KPIs, incidents, and outagesto measure program effectiveness and support continuous improvement

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Risk Management, Emergency Management, or a related field
  • Minimum of 12+ years of experience in business resilience, business continuity, risk management, or related disciplines, with a proven track record of program execution
  • Solid understanding of business resilience principles and crisis management practices
  • Knowledge of shared services operating models and the unique resilience considerations within a global services environment
  • Familiarity with Fusion Risk Management preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to lead crossfunctional initiatives and collaborate across geographies and cultures to influence stakeholders and deliver results
  • Experience managing complex projects involving multiple stakeholders and interdependencies
  • Proven experience designing and leading training programs, workshops, and business resilience exercises or drills
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage, influence, and support leaders at multiple levels of the organization
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Professional certification in Business Continuity or Risk Management
  • Experience working in a large consulting firm (Accenture, McKinsey, EY, PWC, etc.)

What you''ll do at MongoDB
  • Design scalable, secure, and high-performing application, data, and AI architectures using MongoDB Atlas for customer and partner-led solutions

  • Familiarity with modern sales methodologies and strong collaboration with sales leadership
  • The ability to travel up to 25%
You may also have
  • Experience with database programming and data models
  • Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects
  • Experience in transforming legacy systems and platforms into modern, scalable, and efficient technology stacks
  • Experience in SRE practices
  • Proven ability to up-level the broader organization - for example by sharing best practices or creating reusable assets
  • A MongoDB Certification or a Cloud Provider Certification
  • Experience with MongoDB Atlas and adjacent services such as Search, Vector Search, Stream Processing, Data Lake, and related application modernization patterns.
  • Experience with partner technologies and ecosystems such as AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Apache Kafka, or framework-level integrations used in modern AI applications.
  • A track record of public speaking, publishing technical content, or representing a company in external technical forums.
What you will learn
MongoDB Product Suite Mastery
  • Core Database Server: Master the fundamentals and advanced features of MongoDB''s core database
  • Atlas and Advanced Services: Gain expertise in Atlas (fully managed cloud database service), Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, and Charts
  • Relational Migrator: Learn to migrate from relational databases seamlessly
Market-Relevant Technologies:
  • Hyperscaler Ecosystem: Gain expertise in designing complex systems utilizing cloud services on hyperscaler platforms
  • Complementary Technologies: Enhance your skills with partner and complementary technologies such as Apache Kafka and Kubernetes

  • Design Patterns and Methodologies: Embrace best practices in microservices, DevOps, cloud, and security
  • Cutting Edge RAG and AI Architectures: Help customers on their generative AI journeys and working with industry leading partners in the space
Sales Techniques and Soft Skills:

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys blending solution architecture, partner strategy, technical sales, and emerging technology. The strongest candidates will be comfortable operating at the intersection of customer outcomes, partner ecosystems, field enablement, and product innovation.

NAVA Vision AI is looking for a hands-on Principal Computer Vision Architect to own the architecture, deployment, scaling, and productization of production-grade Vision AI solutions across edge, cloud, and hybrid environments.

This role is for someone who has personally deployed and scaled Computer Vision products in real-world environments, not just trained models or built PoCs.

The architect will define how NAVA’s Vision AI platform runs across customer sites, how edge servers and GPUs are selected, how many cameras each configuration supports, how models and pipelines are optimized, and how deployments are standardized for repeatable multi-site rollout.

Architect end-to-end Vision AI systems covering camera ingestion, video pipelines, inference, edge infrastructure, cloud, storage, APIs, monitoring, and multi-site deployment.
Design and optimize multi-camera pipelines using NVIDIA DeepStream, GStreamer, CUDA, TensorRT, and Triton Inference Server.

Design edge, cloud, and hybrid architectures, including production deployments on AWS.
Select and benchmark appropriate edge servers, GPUs, CPU, RAM, storage, and network requirements based on:
Use case
Number of cameras
Resolution and FPS
Number and complexity of models
Latency and performance requirements

jobDescription:
AIVAR INNOVATIONS
Senior Voice AI Engineer - Convogent Delivery
3-5 Years | Coimbatore/ Bangalore |Full-Time
About Aivar Innovations
Aivar Innovations is an AI-native services and software company and an AWS Preferred Partner, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Sorin Investments. We ship production-grade AI into enterprise environments across fintech, healthcare, and technology. Our work is anchored by four accelerator platforms: Convogent (voice and agent AI automation), Velogent (governed agentic process automation for regulated industries), Kubogent (Kubernetes-native AIOps), and Datagent (data and analytics). We measure ourselves by what runs in production, not by slideware.
Role Overview
We are hiring a Senior Voice AI Engineer for Aivars Delivery organization to take voice AI use cases from discovery through live production for our enterprise customers. You will build and customize voice agents on top of Convogent - Aivars voice AI accelerator - working directly within customer engagements, delivery timelines, and SOW commitments. This is a hands-on engineering role embedded in customer-facing delivery pods, partnering closely with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and customer technical stakeholders to ship measurable outcomes on live calls.
What Youll Do
  • Own customer delivery outcomes. Take voice AI use cases from discovery through production go-live within committed timelines, working inside Rocketlane-tracked delivery plans alongside your Delivery Manager.
  • Customize and configure Convogent. Adapt Aivars voice AI accelerator (built on Pipecat, LiveKit) to each customers telephony stack (Twilio, Exotel, Cisco, Vonage, etc.), API/MCP integrations with customer CRM tools, knowledge base (KB) integrations, compliance constraints, and use-case requirements.
  • Engineer real-time audio pipelines for production. Optimize STT and TTS flows for the latency, concurrency, and call quality bar each customer engagement demands.
  • Troubleshoot customer production systems. When a live call does not sound right, quickly narrow down where in the pipeline it broke - capture, STT, orchestration, or TTS - by asking the right questions, reading the right signals, and driving the fix through to resolution.
  • Build and adapt the orchestration layer. Connect STT, TTS, and LLM agents into resilient, observable workflows with guardrails suited to the customers risk and compliance profile.
  • Translate customer requirements into deployable solutions. Work directly with customer technical stakeholders alongside Aivars SA and DM to scope, size, and iterate use cases against measurable outcomes - success rate, latency, adoption.
  • Report and govern delivery. Contribute to sprint tracking, status reporting, and stakeholder governance for the use cases you own.
What Youll Bring
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying voice agents with Pipecat, LiveKit, or similar frameworks - ideally across multiple distinct production deployments, not a single system.
  • Deep expertise in STT (Deepgram, Whisper, AssemblyAI, Google STT, Sarvam) and TTS (ElevenLabs, Cartesia, Amazon Polly).
  • Working knowledge of Speech-to-Speech (S2S) services, including Amazon Nova Sonic, and how they change pipeline and orchestration design compared to cascaded STT/LLM/TTS.
  • Experience with multi-speaker diarization and conversation segmentation.
  • Production fluency in Python plus at least one of Node.js, TypeScript, or Go.
  • Practical use of AI/ML libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn) and conversational AI design - prompt engineering and integration with LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude, Bedrock models).
  • Cloud deployment experience on AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, EKS, Polly, Transcribe, Bedrock) with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.
  • Demonstrated ability to work under SOW/contract constraints - scoping, prioritizing, and shipping within a defined timeline and budget across live customer engagements.
  • Comfort working across multiple concurrent customer engagements with differing requirements, tech stacks, and stakeholders.
Preferred Experience
  • Prior experience in a customer delivery, consulting, or systems integration role, rather than purely product/platform engineering.
  • Exposure to regulated industries (fintech, healthcare, BFSI) and their compliance and security constraints.
  • Experience with enterprise stakeholder management - running status calls, translating technical tradeoffs into business language.
  • Familiarity with low-code voice platforms alongside custom infrastructure.
  • Voice analytics, transcription tooling, and Indian-language STT/TTS models.
  • AWS or speech technology certifications.

Why This Role, Why Aivar

  • Work that ships to real customers. Every use case you build runs live on enterprise calls, measured by customer outcomes, not demos.
  • Own delivery end-to-end. From discovery call to production go-live, you are the engineering owner of the customers voice AI outcome.
  • Build on accelerators that work. Convogent has real production traction - you configure and extend a working platform across diverse customer environments.
  • Direct customer exposure. Work face-to-face with enterprise technical stakeholders, not just internal teams.
  • Backed and proven. AI-native, AWS Preferred Partner, BVP- and Sorin-backed, with 100+ enterprise customers in the first year.

tagsAndSkills: Generative Ai,Power Platform,Copilot,Studio,M365,Artificial Intelligence,Development,Senior
jobDescription:
Copilot Studio Senior Developer

location: Pan India

Role Summary

We are looking for a Copilot Studio Senior Developer to build and ship custom AI agents (copilots) that plug into our clients' Microsoft 365 and Power Platform estates. This is a hands-on role. You will design conversation flows, wire agents to enterprise data and actions, and take them through to production with the right grounding, testing, and guardrails. You should be comfortable owning an agent end to end and mentoring less experienced developers on the team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build custom agents in Copilot Studio, including topics, trigger phrases, conversation flows, and generative answers grounded on enterprise knowledge sources.
  • Configure knowledge sources (SharePoint, Dataverse, public and internal websites, files) and tune grounding so agents give accurate, in-scope responses.
  • Build actions that let agents do real work by connecting to Power Automate flows, connectors, Microsoft Graph, and custom or REST APIs.
  • Implement authentication and secure data access for agents, using Entra ID and appropriate permission scopes.
  • Handle agent lifecycle: environment strategy, solution packaging, testing, and publishing across channels such as Teams, M365 Copilot, and websites.
  • Apply prompt design and generative orchestration to balance scripted control with generative flexibility, and test for accuracy, safety, and unwanted behaviour.
  • Support and troubleshoot agents in production, including analytics review, fixing failed actions, and improving grounding based on usage.
  • Mentor developers and contribute reusable patterns, prompts, and components back to the team.

Must-Have Skills

  • Strong hands-on Copilot Studio experience: topics, generative answers, knowledge sources, actions, and publishing.
  • Solid Power Platform grounding, especially Power Automate and connectors, and working knowledge of Dataverse.
  • Experience connecting agents to data and actions via Microsoft Graph, connectors, and REST APIs.
  • Understanding of Entra ID, authentication, and permission/consent models for secure agent access.
  • Practical prompt engineering and an understanding of generative AI behaviour, grounding, and limitations.
  • Ability to test, monitor, and iterate on agents using the built-in analytics.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Understanding of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) concepts and how grounding, chunking, and retrieval quality affect answer accuracy.
  • Some scripting ability (Python or PowerShell) for custom connectors and Azure Functions.
  • SPFx or Power Apps development for surfacing or embedding agents in custom experiences.
  • Azure services (Functions, Logic Apps, AI services) for extending agents beyond low-code.
  • Exposure to pro-code agent frameworks (Semantic Kernel, Azure AI Foundry) for hybrid low-code plus pro-code scenarios.
  • Awareness of responsible AI, data governance, and DLP considerations.
  • SharePoint Online knowledge for grounding and content-source design.

Experience & Qualifications

Experience: Typically 5 to 8 years across Power Platform / M365 development, with real Copilot Studio delivery experience.

Certifications: PL-400, PL-600, or the Copilot/agent-focused credentials are an advantage.

Soft Skills

  • Comfortable explaining what an agent can and cannot reliably do, and setting expectations with stakeholders.
  • Clear communicator who can turn a business ask into a workable agent design.

jobDescription:
Role summary

As Senior Python Architect, you will own the technical strategy and hands-on design for re-platforming the HIVE backend from PL/SQL to Python. You will reverse-engineer the current codebase, document the embedded business logic and data flows, define a target Python architecture (FastAPI, asynchronous processing, clean data-access patterns), establish a pragmatic and low-risk migration strategy with parity validation, and guide the engineering team through delivery. You will be hands-on producing reference implementations and resolving the hardest technical problems while also setting standards, mentoring engineers, and aligning with SFI's enterprise architecture governance (ARB).

Key responsibilities

Current-state assessment & discovery

  • Review the existing HIVE system end-to-end PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, triggers, cursors, scheduled jobs, and the React front-end touchpoints.
  • Reverse-engineer and document the embedded business logic, data models, integrations, batch/long-running processes, and dependencies that must be preserved.
  • Identify complexity hotspots, technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and risk areas; quantify the conversion effort and produce a phased, prioritized conversion blueprint.

Target architecture & design

  • Define the target-state Python architecture: service decomposition, FastAPI API design, asynchronous execution model (async/await, ASGI), data-access layer, configuration, and deployment topology.
  • Design patterns for asynchronous and long-running jobs (background workers, task queues, concurrency, idempotency, retries) to replace PL/SQL batch and scheduled processing.
  • Establish coding standards, project structure, reusable frameworks/accelerators, and Definition of Done; author Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
  • Define non-functional requirements — performance, scalability, security, observability, and maintainability — and design to meet them.

PL/SQL Python conversion strategy

  • Define a low-risk migration approach (e.g., incremental / strangler-fig) with clear sequencing, rollback paths, and coexistence with the current system during transition.
  • Establish a rigorous parity and data-reconciliation strategy so converted Python logic produces results equivalent to the original PL/SQL (record counts, field-level validation, transformation-rule verification).
  • Decide where logic should move from the database tier into the application tier, and define the data-access strategy against the existing Oracle backend.

Hands-on engineering & leadership

  • Build reference implementations / proofs-of-concept for the highest-risk conversion patterns; set the template the team follows.
  • Provide technical leadership, code review, and mentoring to Python and data engineers within the HIVE Fusion Team.
  • Drive engineering quality: automated testing (pytest), CI/CD, code quality gates, and regression coverage for converted modules.

Collaboration & governance

  • Partner with SFI HIVE / Digital Labs stakeholders to validate business logic and acceptance criteria.
  • Align designs with SFI's Architecture Review Board (ARB) and enterprise standards for security, integration, and platforms.
  • Where applicable, leverage Ascendion's AAVA platform and AI-assisted tooling to accelerate code understanding, conversion, and test generation.

Required skills & experience (must-have)

  • Python expert (3.10+): idiomatic, production-grade Python with strong design and OOP/functional fundamentals.
  • FastAPI: deep, hands-on experience designing and building REST APIs with FastAPI (Pydantic, dependency injection, ASGI servers such as Uvicorn/Gunicorn).
  • Asynchronous programming: strong command of asyncio, async/await, concurrency, and async I/O; designing asynchronous and long-running job execution.
  • PL/SQL & SQL (deep): expert ability to read, reverse-engineer, and translate large PL/SQL codebases — packages, procedures, functions, triggers, cursors — and tune SQL for performance.
  • Oracle database: solid working knowledge of Oracle (the current HIVE backend), data modeling, and query optimization.
  • AWS: hands-on experience designing, deploying, and running Python services on AWS — e.g., Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, RDS, S3, and IAM — including cost-aware, secure, and scalable cloud-native patterns.
  • Full-stack awareness: comfortable across the stack, including integration with a React front end and clean API contracts.
  • Application modernization / migration: proven track record converting or re-platforming legacy systems to modern Python services, with parity validation and zero-regression discipline.
  • Architecture: demonstrated experience as a solution/application architect — target-state design, NFRs, ADRs, and setting engineering standards.
  • Engineering practices: Git/GitHub, CI/CD, automated testing (pytest), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
  • Experience: typically 10+ years in software engineering with 4+ years in a senior architect capacity on data-intensive, business-critical systems.

Preferred / nice-to-have

  • Data access / ORM frameworks (e.g., SQLAlchemy), task queues / background workers (e.g., Celery, arq, RQ), and message/event-driven patterns.
  • Cloud & data platforms: Azure, GCP (incl. Gemini Enterprise); Databricks; Power BI / semantic layers.
  • AI / agentic engineering, GenAI-assisted code conversion, and exposure to AI acceleration platforms (e.g., AAVA).
  • Warehouse-management / supply-chain or food & CPG / manufacturing domain exposure.
  • Observability (logging, metrics, tracing) and API security best practices (authN/authZ, secrets management).

About the Role

We are looking for an ambitious, highly motivated and forward-thinking AI Integration, Automation & Innovation Lead to take ownership of the research, development, implementation and integration of Artificial Intelligence across our organisation.

This is not simply an IT support or ChatGPT-based role. We are looking for someone who is genuinely passionate about AI, automation and emerging technology and wants to become deeply involved in helping us build an AI-enabled organisation.

You will work closely with senior management, learn how different areas of the company operate, identify opportunities for improvement and develop practical AI and automation solutions that improve efficiency, education, administration, marketing, customer experience and overall business performance.


The role combines AI research, development, automation, integration, dashboard creation, data visualisation, experimentation, implementation, training and strategic thinking.

jobDescription:
ROLE OVERVIEW

The Associate Client Engagement Manager works alongside the senior Client Engagement Manager to drive Celebal's commercial and client engagement activity across the GCC primarily Saudi Arabia and the UAE — with a clear path to owning accounts and transactions outright.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role, but it is not a coordination role. You will be expected to hold your own in a first conversation with a Microsoft solution specialist or a client stakeholder without a technical colleague on the call, to explain what Celebal does differently in a specific solution area, and to build and defend a commercial estimate. Pre-sales, delivery and practice teams support you; they do not substitute for you.

Read this before applying: the interview includes a live technical and commercial assessment. Candidates who position themselves as functional or relationship-only sellers, and who require pre-sales support for every solution conversation, are not a fit for this role — regardless of years of experience or account pedigree.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Pipeline Ownership & Deal Progression

  • Own and progress a defined slice of the GCC opportunity pipeline — from qualification through proposal submission, negotiation support and closure — with the senior CEM as escalation point rather than as approver of every step.
  • Run RFP, RFI and tender responses end to end: interpret requirements, decompose the scope, own the response plan and timeline, drive contributions from pre-sales and practice leads, and assemble a submission that is compliant and commercially sound.
  • Manage Microsoft and partner co-sell motions directly — deal registration, co-sell submissions, MCI/ECIF and pre-sales funding nominations, and joint account planning with Microsoft SSPs, ATUs and partner leads (Crayon and others).
  • Maintain CRM hygiene, forecast accuracy and pipeline reporting to a standard that leadership can act on without rework.
  • Schedule and lead client meetings, demos and technical presentations; author the meeting narrative and the follow-up MOM, not just the logistics.

2. Client Engagement & Account Ownership

  • Act as a named point of contact for assigned accounts, holding day-to-day commercial and delivery-liaison conversations independently.
  • Produce client-facing material — proposals, BoQ and BoM summaries, executive briefings, project status narratives — in a form that goes to the client with light review, not heavy rewriting.
  • Track milestone status with delivery, trigger milestone-linked commercial actions, and own invoicing follow-up, collections escalation and revenue realisation for your accounts.
  • Maintain complete, auditable engagement documentation: MSAs, SOWs, Change Requests, LOIs, correspondence and approval trails.

3. Solution Positioning & Differentiation

  • Articulate what Celebal does differently in specific solution areas — Microsoft Fabric and Databricks-based data platform modernisation, migration accelerators, GenAI and agentic use cases, sovereign cloud and security — and why that beats an incumbent system integrator. This is a core competency of the role, not a marketing hand-off.
  • Maintain and actively use the GCC solution narrative: capability decks, reference architectures, case studies, industry-specific use-case libraries and competitive positioning.
  • Translate a client problem statement into an indicative solution shape and commercial envelope in the room, then validate it with pre-sales — rather than deferring the entire conversation.

4. Proposal, Estimation & Commercial Construction

  • Author the executive summary, scope of work, assumptions, exclusions and commercial sections of proposals; source tech stack, effort estimates and delivery timelines from pre-sales and delivery and integrate them coherently.
  • Build and adjust Azure consumption estimates independently using the Azure pricing calculator — storage, compute, capacity SKUs and licensing — and understand how those choices move the client's total cost.
  • Draft quotations, SOW summaries and Change Request documentation; understand the difference between T&M, fixed-price, managed-capacity and outcome-based structures and when each is appropriate.

5. Internal Coordination & Governance

  • Liaise with delivery, legal, finance and HR on engagement onboarding, commercial issue resolution and contract execution.
  • Prepare internal briefing notes, commercial summaries, deal review packs and escalation memos of a standard suitable for regional leadership review.
  • Contribute to WBS updates, revenue forecasting and weekly/monthly business reviews.
  • Ensure clean account handovers with full context and documentation captured.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Essential — screened against, no exceptions

  • GCC market experience. 4–6 years in B2B technology sales, client engagement, pre-sales or account management, including demonstrable UAE and/or KSA market experience — in-market work history, or documented ownership of GCC-based client relationships. Regional exposure gained purely through remote channel coordination does not meet this requirement.
  • Microsoft partner ecosystem depth. Hands-on experience with co-sell motions, deal registration, and pre-sales or partner funding mechanisms (MCI, ECIF or equivalent), including working relationships with Microsoft field roles (SSP, ATU, partner development).
  • Data & AI portfolio literacy. Working knowledge of the Microsoft data and AI stack — Azure data services, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Power BI, GenAI/Copilot patterns — sufficient to scope a data platform, migration or AI use-case conversation unaided.
  • Cloud and security fundamentals. Practical fluency in Azure architecture basics, M365/O365, and Microsoft security and compliance (Sentinel, Defender, identity). Certification at fundamentals level or above (AZ-900, MS-900, SC-900, DP-900 or higher) is expected; equivalent demonstrated knowledge is acceptable.
  • Estimation capability. Able to build and defend an Azure consumption estimate on the Azure pricing calculator without pre-sales assistance. This is tested live during interview.
  • RFP and tender ownership. Direct experience running or substantially owning RFP, RFI or government tender responses, including compliance and commercial sections.
  • Services-commercial exposure. Familiarity with MSAs, SOWs and Change Requests, and with authoring scope and commercial terms for services engagements — as distinct from licensing or product resale.
  • Deal scale. Experience on engagements where individual proof-of-concept values reach USD 150K or above and multi-year programmes exceed USD 1M. Celebal proof-of-concept engagements alone routinely run USD 200K–250K.
  • Applied AI fluency. Uses AI tooling deliberately in the sales craft — research, account intelligence, first-draft proposal and RFP response construction, competitive analysis — with judgement about what must still be authored and verified by a human.
  • Communication. Clear, professional written and spoken English; able to produce client-ready correspondence and documents with minimal supervision.
  • Education. Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field. MBA or a technical postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
  • Mobility. Based in or willing to relocate to Dubai, with a valid ability to travel across KSA and the GCC.

Preferred

  • Arabic language capability.
  • Prior employment with a Microsoft partner, system integrator or technology consulting firm serving enterprise clients in the region.
  • Account experience in logistics, government or public sector, FMCG, or financial services in the GCC.
  • Exposure to sovereign cloud, data residency or regional compliance requirements (SDAIA, NDMO, UAE data protection).
  • Experience with CRM and revenue tooling — Dynamics 365, Salesforce, HubSpot, Clari.
  • Familiarity with government procurement portals and tender platforms in KSA or the UAE.

COMPETENCIES

  • Technical credibility. Can hold a solution conversation with an architect or Microsoft specialist and be taken seriously. This is the single most important competency in the role.
  • Commercial judgement. Understands deal structures, pricing models, margin implications and revenue recognition well enough to shape a deal, not just document it.
  • Independent ownership. Moves an opportunity forward without waiting to be told the next step; escalates with a recommendation attached.
  • Competitive framing. Can explain why Celebal, in a specific solution area, against a specific incumbent, in under two minutes.
  • Organisational rigour. Manages concurrent engagements with accurate documentation, clean CRM and reliable follow-through.
  • Stakeholder navigation. Comfortable across pre-sales, delivery, legal and finance internally, and across client procurement, IT and business stakeholders externally.
  • Cross-cultural effectiveness. Operates credibly in GCC business culture and with distributed India-based delivery teams.
  • Adaptability. Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth regional business with evolving priorities.

SELECTION PROCESS

Candidates should expect a structured assessment rather than a conversational interview. The process comprises an HR screening, a technical and commercial round with sales leadership, and a regional fit discussion.

What we assess


How

Solution positioning


You will be asked to pitch Celebal cold to a Microsoft SSP covering a named industry, and to answer why a client should move work to us from an incumbent SI. Generic value statements do not clear this stage.

Commercial sizing


You will be asked to open the Azure pricing calculator on screen and build or adjust a simple estimate — storage, compute, capacity SKU — without pre-sales support.

Solution depth


You will be asked to walk through the most technically complex engagement you have sold, including data sources, integration approach and platform choices, in your own words.

Commercial structure


You will be asked how a proposal is assembled — which sections you author, which you source from pre-sales and delivery, and how pricing model and timelines are arrived at.


CAREER PATH

This role is a structured route into a full Client Engagement Manager position. Candidates who demonstrate technical credibility, commercial judgement and independent account ownership will be considered for progression within 18–24 months. Progression is assessed on independent deal ownership and solution credibility, not tenure.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
  • Direct exposure to marquee enterprise and government accounts across the GCC.
  • Close collaboration with Microsoft field and product teams, including global initiative and sovereign cloud programmes.
  • Structured mentorship from experienced regional sales leadership.
  • Funded certification pathways across Azure, Data & AI, and Security.
  • Fast-track growth in a priority geography, within a global team spanning the Americas, EMEA, India, APJ, Australia and Japan.

Kearney Activate is the business acceleration and enablement arm of Kearney Management Consulting, helping clients accelerate transformation through Data and AI.Our Data & AI business line bridges strategy, technology, and execution to deliver data-driven, AI-enabled,and cloud-powered transformations. We partner with leading platforms such as Microsoft, AWS,Snowflake, Databricks and Nvidia to help organizations build trusted data foundations, deploy intelligent solutions, and scale innovation.

  • Advisory & Assurance Services: Driving strategy, governance, and change management to ensure impactful transformation.
  • Data Services: Building trusted, high-quality data foundations using Agentic AI across engineering, architecture, and governance. Insights Services: Unlocking value through analytics, data science, and AI-driven storytelling for better decision-making.

About the Role


As a Junior Applied AI Solution Engineer, you will work as part of a cross-functional teams to design, build, and deploy AI-driven applications. Particularly those leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs),agents, and other modern AI techniques. This is a hands-on, client-facing engineering role where you will contribute to solution design, development, testing, and delivery.


You will work closely with senior engineers and client teams, gaining exposure to real-world AI solution engineering. As you grow in the role, you will take on more ownership, from end-to-end delivery to

advising clients on AI opportunities and best practices.

Our teams primarily build solutions using existing foundational models (closed and open-source), sometimes with light fine-tuning. We do not train foundational models from scratch.

1. AI Solution Development

  • Support the design and hands-on implementation of end-to-end solutions with guidance from senior engineers.

3. Client Collaboration & Communication

  • Participate in conversations with clients to understand their challenges, use cases, and requirements.
  • Help translate business needs into feasible AI/ML solution components.
  • Support senior engineers in presenting solution concepts and explaining AI capabilities in accessible terms.

4. Technical Problem-Solving

  • Proactively learn new technologies and explore innovative ways to apply AI to real-world problems.
  • Experiment with new open-source models, orchestration frameworks, and retrieval techniques.
  • Share findings and help improve team practices.

Technical Skills


You have hands-on experience or strong foundational knowledge in several of the following areas:

  • Python programming and data technologies (SQL, APIs, basic data pipelines).

jobDescription:
Senior Staff Engineer AI & Agentic Engineering


Location: India (Flexible — WFO preferred, otherwise 2 quarterly visits are compulsory)


The Role

As Senior Staff Engineer, you'll be one of the senior-most individual contributors driving that shift from the engineering side — turning "we should use AI here" into working, production systems. This is not a role where the product hands you a spec. You'll often be the one deciding what's worth building before anyone else has framed the problem.


Your core mandate is threefold:

  1. Build agentic capability into the core platform. Design and ship AI/agent-driven features — autonomous workflows, decision engines, LLM-integrated tooling — into a commerce platform already processing billions in transaction volume.
  2. Operate at the edge of ambiguity. Take a rough direction, not a groomed backlog, and turn it into a scoped, shippable plan yourself. You'll be trusted to define the "what" as much as the "how."
  3. Set the technical bar for how we build with AI. You won't be the only engineer touching this space — you'll help shape the standard others follow.

What You'll Walk Into

  • An agentic initiative already underway — early proof-of-concept work has shipped, momentum exists, but there's no dedicated senior technical owner driving it end-to-end yet
  • A production platform with deep integrations across QuickBooks, Shopify, Amazon, eBay, and more — technically complex and high-stakes
  • Owning distinct areas of the platform — you'll have real IC peers at your level, not just reports
  • A manager who will be a technical thought partner, not a filter — you'll engage directly with architecture and roadmap decisions, not through a PM layer

What You'll Do

Agentic Product Development

  • Design and build AI/agent-driven features across the commerce platform — from proof-of-concept to production
  • Own ambiguous, 0-to-1 problems end-to-end without waiting on a fully-groomed spec

Technical Ownership & Craft

  • Make and defend architecture calls independently; bring options with tradeoffs, not open-ended questions
  • Partner with our architecture function on how agentic systems integrate cleanly into the existing platform layer, rather than bypassing it

Roadmap & Direction

  • Partner with engineering and product leadership on what to build, not just receive requirements — shape the roadmap, don't just consume it
  • Identify where AI creates real leverage for customers (vs. where it's just a buzzword) and make the case for it

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Set technical direction for others working in the agentic space; raise the bar on how the team builds with AI
  • Communicate decisions and tradeoffs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders

What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

  • 8+ years in backend/systems engineering, with real production experience owning complex systems end-to-end
  • Hands-on fluency with AI/LLM tooling — you've built with agents, RAG, tool-calling, or similar, not just used ChatGPT
  • Demonstrated comfort operating without a fully-defined spec — a track record of shaping a fuzzy problem into a concrete, shippable plan
  • Strong, independent architectural judgment — comfortable defending a design decision under scrutiny
  • Self-directed — you don't need a product manager to break down the work before you can start
  • Clear communicator — can explain a technical decision and its tradeoffs to both engineers and leadership

Strong advantages:

  • Experience with .NET / C# (our core stack)
  • Prior experience in a startup or small-team environment where you owned ambiguity by necessity, not choice
  • Exposure to e-commerce, ERP, or integration-heavy platforms

Why Join Webgility

  • Real impact: Your work directly shapes how thousands of small businesses operate, not just how data moves between systems
  • Builder's role: You're defining Webgility's agentic capability, not maintaining an established roadmap someone else set
  • Domain depth: Ecommerce + accounting is a complex, high-stakes integration problem with a large TAM
  • Direct access: You'll work closely with engineering leadership on architecture and direction, with real influence over what gets built next

Webgility is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse perspectives and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

jobDescription:
Candidates should have experience in Legal Industry, in Knowledge Management / Intellectual Property Management


Span of Control: Innovate Knowledge Solutions, Improve Lawyer Productivity, and Enhance Client Service delivery. S/he should also drive adoption of emerging technologies including AI, and others


Qualification: LLB / LLM (Mandatory)


Designation: Manager

Post Qualification Experience: 812 years of experience in Knowledge Management, preferably within a leading Law Firm or Professional Services organization


Location: Bombay


Reporting to: Chief Knowledge Officer


ROLE PURPOSE


The Manager - Knowledge Management will play a pivotal role in driving the firm's knowledge strategy, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing, and ensuring that legal knowledge assets are effectively managed, leveraged, and continuously enhanced to support business objectives.

The role requires a strategic thinker who can partner closely with Partners, Practice Heads, lawyers, and business services teams to develop innovative knowledge solutions, improve lawyer productivity, and enhance client service delivery. The incumbent will lead key KM initiatives, oversee the firm's knowledge repositories and precedent management programs, drive adoption of emerging technologies including AI, and ensure that knowledge resources remain accurate, accessible, and commercially valuable.

As a trusted advisor and relationship manager, the individual will collaborate across practice groups to identify knowledge gaps, implement best practices, and establish governance frameworks that promote consistency, quality, and efficiency throughout the firm.


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES


Knowledge Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop, implement, and continuously refine the firm's Knowledge Management strategy in alignment with business goals and practice area priorities.
  • Partner with Practice Heads and Partners to identify strategic KM opportunities and drive knowledge-led initiatives.
  • Establish governance frameworks, policies, and standards for knowledge creation, maintenance, validation, and archival.
  • Lead firm-wide KM transformation and modernization initiatives.
  • Drive a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning across the organization.

Legal Knowledge & Precedent Management

  • Oversee the firm's precedent, know-how, and legal content management programs.
  • Ensure high-quality, current, and commercially relevant precedents are maintained across all practice groups.
  • Develop frameworks for capturing, organizing, and disseminating legal know-how and matter experience.
  • Lead initiatives to capture tacit knowledge from senior lawyers and departing professionals.
  • Establish quality assurance processes for legal content and knowledge assets.

Knowledge Systems & Technology

  • Lead the evolution of KM platforms, document repositories, and knowledge solutions.
  • Work closely with IT, Digital, and Innovation teams to implement technology-driven KM solutions.
  • Drive adoption of AI-enabled legal technologies, search solutions, and automation tools.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve knowledge discovery and lawyer productivity.
  • Ensure effective metadata, taxonomy, and content classification frameworks are maintained across KM systems.

Stakeholder Management & Relationship Building

  • Serve as the primary KM partner for assigned practice groups and business functions.
  • Build strong relationships with Partners, lawyers, and leadership teams to understand business requirements and deliver tailored KM solutions.
  • Act as a change champion to encourage adoption of KM initiatives and technologies.
  • Facilitate cross-practice collaboration and sharing of best practices.

Knowledge Sharing, Training & Communication

  • Develop and execute engagement programs to promote KM awareness and adoption.
  • Design and deliver KM training sessions, workshops, and awareness campaigns.
  • Support communication strategies that showcase KM successes, new resources, and thought leadership.
  • Create initiatives that encourage lawyer participation and knowledge contribution.

AI, Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive the adoption of AI and legal technology solutions to enhance knowledge capture, search, retrieval, and lawyer productivity.
  • Identify, evaluate, and implement AI-powered KM initiatives aligned with the firm's strategic objectives.
  • Partner with legal, technology, and business teams to develop scalable AI use cases and drive user adoption.
  • Establish best practices and governance frameworks for the responsible and secure use of AI within the firm.
  • Stay abreast of emerging AI and legal tech trends, continuously identifying opportunities to improve KM processes and user experience.
  • Measure the impact of AI initiatives through analytics and recommend enhancements to maximize business value.

Analytics & Performance Management

  • Develop KPIs and dashboards to measure KM effectiveness, engagement, and business impact.
  • Monitor usage patterns, search behavior, content contribution, and adoption metrics.
  • Provide strategic recommendations based on data insights.
  • Report KM performance and outcomes to leadership on a regular basis.

Team Leadership

  • Mentor and develop KM team members.
  • Provide guidance, coaching, and performance management support.
  • Foster a high-performance, collaborative, and innovative team culture.
  • Manage multiple projects and priorities while ensuring timely delivery.


EXPERIENCE AND COMPETENCIES


Education & Experience

  • A Law Graduate / Post-Graduate (mandatory) with 8-12 years of experience in Knowledge Management, preferably within a leading law firm or professional services organisation.
  • Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing KM strategies.
  • Experience managing legal precedents, knowledge repositories, and content governance programs.
  • Strong exposure to legal research databases, document management systems, and enterprise search solutions.
  • Experience working with SharePoint, Microsoft 365, iManage, or similar platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered legal technologies and knowledge solutions.
  • Proven experience managing senior stakeholders, including Partners and Practice Heads.
  • Prior people management experience preferred

Essential Competencies (Skills & Attributes)

Strong understanding of legal Knowledge Management principles and best practices.

  • Expertise in precedent management, content governance, taxonomy development, and legal knowledge organization.
  • Strong understanding of legal research methodologies and legal information resources.
  • Experience implementing and managing enterprise KM platforms.
  • Knowledge of AI, Generative AI, legal technology solutions, and automation tools.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives.
  • Excellent project and change management skills.
  • Strong commercial awareness and business acumen.

jobDescription:
Job Description Data Architect Consultant
Position: Data Architect Consultant | Modern Data & AI Architecture
Experience: 10+ years
Mode- Freelancer/ Consultant
Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced Data Architect Consultant to design scalable, secure and high-performance enterprise data architectures across cloud, data platforms, analytics and AI workloads.
The candidate will work with business, engineering, analytics and AI teams to define end-to-end data architecture, including data ingestion, integration, storage, processing, modeling, governance, security and consumption.
The role also requires the ability to design AI-ready data platforms supporting Generative AI, RAG, AI agents and advanced analytics.
Required Skills
Must Have
10+ years of experience in Data Engineering / Data Architecture.
Strong experience designing enterprise data architectures.
Strong SQL and data modeling expertise.
Experience with Data Warehouse / Data Lake / Lakehouse architectures.
Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform AWS, Azure or GCP.
Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric or BigQuery.
Strong understanding of ETL/ELT, APIs, batch and streaming architectures.
Strong understanding of data governance, security, quality and lineage.
Experience working with senior business and technical stakeholders.
AI / GenAI Required
Understanding of AI-ready data architecture.
Practical exposure to GenAI / LLM / RAG architectures.
Understanding of vector databases and semantic/hybrid search.
Understanding of how enterprise data is consumed by AI applications and agents.
Good to Have
Data Mesh / Data Fabric experience.
Apache Kafka / event-driven architecture.
Apache Iceberg / Delta Lake.
Microsoft Fabric.
Databricks.
Snowflake.
Data Vault.
Knowledge Graphs / Graph databases.
Experience with MCP / Agentic AI architectures.
Experience with AI data governance.
Experience with ML/AI platforms and MLOps.
Terraform / Infrastructure as Code.
FinOps / cloud cost optimization.

Key Responsibilities
1. Data Architecture & Strategy
Define enterprise and solution-level data architecture strategies and roadmaps.
Design scalable architectures across Data Warehouse, Data Lake, Lakehouse, Data Fabric and Data Mesh patterns.
Evaluate build-vs-buy, technology and platform choices based on business, scalability, cost and performance requirements.
Define architecture standards, principles and reusable patterns.
2. Modern Data Platforms
Design cloud-native data platforms across AWS, Azure and/or GCP.
Architect modern lakehouse solutions using technologies such as:
oDatabricks
oSnowflake
oMicrosoft Fabric
oBigQuery
oDelta Lake / Apache Iceberg
Design batch, near-real-time and real-time data processing architectures.
3. Data Engineering & Integration
Define architecture for:
oETL/ELT
oAPI-based integration
oStreaming pipelines
oEvent-driven architectures
oData ingestion and transformation
Work with Data Engineers to establish scalable and reusable pipeline patterns.
Define integration strategies across enterprise applications and data sources.
4. Data Modeling
Design:
oConceptual, logical and physical data models
o3NF models
oDimensional models
oStar/Snowflake schemas
oData Vault where applicable
Define enterprise data models, master data and business semantics.
Establish standards for structured and unstructured data.
5. Data Governance & Security
Define enterprise data governance frameworks covering:
oData ownership
oData quality
oMetadata
oData lineage
oData classification
oRetention
oAccess control
Work with platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog, Collibra, Alation or equivalent.
Ensure compliance, privacy and security requirements are incorporated into architecture.
AI / GenAI Data Architecture
This should be a key differentiator for the modern Data Architect profile.
6. AI-Ready Data Architecture
Design data architectures that support Generative AI, RAG, AI copilots and Agentic AI.
Define how structured, unstructured and semi-structured enterprise data can be made available to AI systems.
Design data pipelines for AI ingestion, preprocessing, metadata and retrieval.
Define architecture for enterprise knowledge bases and AI-ready data products.
Modern AI systems increasingly require more than a basic vector database; production RAG architectures need ingestion, metadata, retrieval, evaluation, governance and access controls.
7. RAG & Retrieval Architecture
Design enterprise RAG architectures using:
oEmbeddings
oVector databases
oHybrid search
oMetadata filtering
oSemantic search
oRe-ranking
Evaluate technologies such as Pinecone, Azure AI Search, OpenSearch, PostgreSQL/pgvector, Databricks Vector Search or equivalent.
Define strategies for document ingestion, chunking, indexing, retrieval and data freshness.
8. Agentic AI Data Foundation
Design data access patterns for AI agents and multi-agent systems.
Define how agents securely access enterprise data, APIs and knowledge repositories.
Design structured and unstructured data interfaces suitable for agent consumption.
Understand concepts such as MCP, tool calling, agent memory and knowledge retrieval.
The shift toward AI-native lakehouse architectures is specifically driving requirements for continuous data, multimodal data and reliable context for AI agents.
Data Quality & Observability
Establish enterprise data quality frameworks and standards.
Define quality rules, validation frameworks and data contracts.
Implement monitoring for:
oData freshness
oCompleteness
oAccuracy
oConsistency
oPipeline failures
Define observability and lineage requirements across the data platform.
Performance & Cost Optimization
Design architectures for high-volume and high-throughput workloads.
Optimize storage, compute and data processing costs.
Define partitioning, caching, indexing and query optimization strategies.
Evaluate cloud/data platform cost-performance trade-offs.
Establish architecture-level scalability and performance benchmarks.
AI Governance & Responsible Data Use
Ensure AI solutions follow enterprise data governance and security requirements.
Define access controls for data used by LLMs, RAG systems and AI agents.
Address:
oPII / sensitive data
oData leakage
oAuthorization
oData provenance
oAuditability
oRetention
Ensure AI systems access only the data users are authorized to access.
This is increasingly important because AI/RAG governance needs to enforce authorization and data controls at runtime, not simply at the catalog level.

jobDescription:
Are you the kind of tech leader who looks at a manual process and thinks, Surely we can automate this?


We expect this role to run a modern, AI-native engineering practice rather than a traditional development team. In practice that means:


  • AI-assisted by default: modern coding tools and agents are part of everyday development, not an experiment. You decide where they are used and hold the team to a consistent standard of output.
  • Human accountability, always: AI accelerates the work, but a named human owns every design decision and every line that ships. Security-sensitive and customer-facing code is always human-reviewed.
  • Tool-agnostic: you pick the right tool for the job across the ecosystem GitHub Copilot and Copilot Workspace as a Microsoft-first default, alongside tools such as Cursor and Claude Code and re-evaluate as the field moves.
  • Multi-cloud: you are equally comfortable designing and deploying on both Azure and AWS, and choosing between them on merit.
  • Leverage over headcount: a smaller team that is deliberate about tooling, architecture and reuse, rather than scaling by adding people.

Location: Mohali/Chandigarh (Flexi- 1 WFH a week)



About us

Oreta is a multi-award-winning Australian technology and cybersecurity organisation, renowned for delivering transformative cloud and infrastructure solutions. Recognized by industry leaders such as ARN, CRN, and Telstra, Oreta has consistently demonstrated its commitment to innovation and excellence.


As a Microsoft Gold Partner in Cloud Platform, Oreta has showcased deep expertise in deploying advanced cloud solutions, particularly leveraging Microsoft Azure. This prestigious status reflects the company's rigorous technical proficiency and its dedication to helping clients modernize their infrastructure efficiently.


Further cementing its position in the industry, Oreta was honored with the Breakthrough Partner of the Year award at the Ingram Micro ONE Innovation Summit. This accolade recognized Oreta's holistic solutions, including security bundles based on Microsoft Sentinel, Copilot Assessments, and initiatives driving Azure growth through infrastructure migration and AI adoption.

With a proven track record of optimizing costs, streamlining operations, and enhancing network performance, Oreta stands out as a go-to partner for businesses aiming to embrace secure and modern digital ecosystems.


With a track record of delivering over 150 cloud projects and managing more than 1,400 network sites, Oreta continues to drive business transformation through agility, innovation, and enhanced user experiences .


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the technical delivery of Oretas software products end to end architecture, design, development, review, testing and release across a diverse, multi-cloud technology stack.
  • Lead a small, high-leverage engineering team, setting the standard for how work is planned, built, reviewed and shipped.
  • Define and own the teams approach to AI-assisted development: which tools are used (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code), where they add value, and the guardrails that govern their use.
  • Review and verify AI-generated and human-written code to the same high standard, with particular rigour around security, licensing, third-party dependencies and long-term maintainability.
  • Design, build and document scalable, maintainable software components and services across the front end, back end and data layers.
  • Architect and build AI-native features into Oretas products moving beyond using AI to build, to embedding AI capability in what customers use.
  • Own technical change management, source control, CI/CD pipelines and technical documentation using modern best practice.
  • Design and evolve data models and database architecture; ensure data is stored, retrieved and secured efficiently across relational and non-relational stores.
  • Evaluate third-party components, frameworks, cloud services and AI tooling for inclusion in the product architecture.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship, growing the capability of the team including how they work effectively and safely with AI tooling.
  • Collaborate with product and business stakeholders to translate needs into technical direction, and communicate status, trade-offs and risk clearly.
  • Drive initiatives to modernise existing product architectures, and present findings and recommendations to senior management in a clear, actionable manner.
  • Ensure design and build documentation in Oretas systems is accurate and consistent, fostering clarity across operational processes.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience as a technical lead, software architect or senior full stack engineer, with genuine architect-level depth and a track record of shipping production software.
  • Strong software design fundamentals — design principles, architectural patterns and the judgement to know when to apply them. These matter more, not less, when reviewing AI-generated code at volume.
  • Hands-on full stack capability across a modern back end (e.g. C#/.NET, Python, Node.js) and front end (e.g. React/TypeScript or equivalent), with strong API design (REST/JSON, and familiarity with GraphQL).
  • Demonstrated, practical use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code), and the ability to set standards for their safe and effective use — including reviewing and verifying AI-generated code.
  • Multi-cloud engineering experience: designing, deploying and operating applications on both Azure and AWS, including their managed application, container and serverless services.
  • Strong database and data skills, including:
  • Relational database design and development — e.g. SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Azure SQL, Amazon RDS/Aurora — with advanced SQL.
  • Data modelling for both transactional (OLTP) and analytical/reporting (OLAP) workloads.
  • Query optimisation and performance tuning — indexing strategy, execution plans and troubleshooting slow queries.
  • Working knowledge of NoSQL / non-relational stores (e.g. Cosmos DB, DynamoDB) and sound judgement on when to use them.
  • Data migration, backup/restore and integrity across environments and clouds.
  • Solid grounding in modern delivery: Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code and automated testing.
  • Security-conscious by default — fitting for Oreta’s cyber security heritage — across application code, dependencies, data and cloud configuration.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to break complex technical challenges into pragmatic, well-reasoned solutions.
  • Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to mentor engineers and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
  • Relevant certifications are a plus — e.g. Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or TOGAF.

Perks and benefits


Oreta takes pride in providing a service of excellence to our customers and looking after our employees who enable our business to succeed. The successful applicant will enjoy working in a collaborative environment in Chandigarh, India with a friendly and highly driven people (the Oreos), where ideas are always welcome and ongoing training and development is strongly encouraged. The renumeration will be negotiated and based on the relevant skills and experience of the successful applicant. If you are interested in a long-term career with potential to develop and grow with the business and are available to start immediately, then we look forward to hearing from you.
